title: A Journey Together
content:
The journey to Jammu began early the next morning.

A gentle breeze flowed through the open roads as their car slowly left Delhi behind. The crowded city faded away, replaced by peaceful landscapes and distant mountains that gradually appeared on the horizon.

Their favourite songs played softly through the speakers.

Siddu and Sneha sat together in the back seat.

For a while, they simply enjoyed the music.

Sometimes they sang along.

Sometimes they laughed at forgotten lyrics.

And sometimes...

They just watched the beautiful scenery passing by in comfortable silence.

Hours passed.

The rhythmic movement of the car and the cool breeze entering through the window slowly made Sneha feel sleepy.

Without even realizing it...

She leaned her head gently against Siddu's shoulder.

A few moments later, she unconsciously wrapped one of her hands around his arm, as though she had found the safest place to rest.

Siddu looked down in surprise.

A faint smile appeared on his face.

Carefully, he lowered the volume of the music and removed his headphones, making sure nothing disturbed her sleep.

For a moment, he thought about moving his arm away.

But if he did...

She would wake up.

So, he simply remained still.

The warmth of her head resting on his shoulder stirred a memory he had buried deep inside his heart.

For an instant...

Shreya's face flashed through his mind.

Siddu quietly closed his eyes.

"No..."

He gently pushed the thought away.

"This is different."

This wasn't the same feeling.

This wasn't the same story.

And before long...

Even Siddu drifted into a peaceful sleep.

________________________________________

Several hours later...

Sneha slowly opened her eyes.

For a few seconds, she couldn't understand where she was.

Then she realized...

Her head was resting on Siddu's shoulder.

And her hand was still holding his arm.

Her eyes widened in embarrassment.

"Oh no..."

She carefully lifted her head and slowly withdrew her hand, making sure not to disturb him.

Siddu remained peacefully asleep.

For the first time since they had met...

Sneha quietly observed him.

The calmness on his face...

The innocence in his expression...

The gentle smile that remained even in his sleep...

Without realizing it, she found herself unable to look away.

Just then...

Siddu slowly opened his eyes.

Their eyes almost met.

Caught off guard, Sneha immediately turned away.

Siddu stretched his arms and looked at her.

"What happened?" he asked.

Sneha quickly shook her head.

"Nothing."

A small smile appeared on Siddu's face.

He didn't ask anything further.

A few minutes later...

The driver looked back and smiled.

"Sir... Madam..."

"We've reached Jammu."

Both of them stepped out of the car.

The moment the cool mountain breeze touched them, they shivered.

"What a climate!" Sneha exclaimed, rubbing her hands together.

Siddu smiled as he looked at the snow-covered mountains surrounding the city.

The fresh air...

The peaceful atmosphere...

Everything felt refreshing.

After spending a few moments enjoying the beauty around them, they headed to a nearby restaurant and had lunch together.

By evening, they began searching for a hotel.

Unfortunately...

The tourist season had filled almost every room.

One hotel after another gave them the same answer.

"No vacancies."

Finally, after searching for a long time, they found a hotel with only one room available.

Siddu immediately looked at Sneha.

"Let's check another hotel."

He searched online again.

He called a few more places.

But every hotel was fully booked.

Sneha looked at him and smiled gently.

"I don't mind sharing the room."

Siddu remained silent for a few moments.

He knew they didn't have any other option.

Finally...

He nodded.

"Alright."

After collecting the room key from the reception, they quietly walked toward their room.

Neither of them spoke.

Neither of them realized...

That the night waiting ahead would quietly change the way they saw each other forever.
